description: Bring your own video, audio or image into a project — not generated, yours. Two ways: `media_url` (a public http(s) address; the server fetches it, max 100 MB) or `file_name` + `content_type` (you get a signed `upload_url`: PUT the file's raw bytes there with that content type within the hour, e.g. `curl -X PUT -H 'content-type: video/mp4' --data-binary @clip.mp4 '<upload_url>'`). Either way the answer is the `asset_key` — use it in lab_timeline_apply as clips[].asset_key (video) or bett.asset_key (audio). Free. Internal addresses are refused.

content_type.description: Media type of the upload, e.g. video/mp4, audio/mpeg — required with file_name

file_name.description: Name of a local file to upload, with extension. Give this OR media_url

media_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file. Give this OR file_name

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

name: lab_add_media
title: Add Media
